text: Moreover”—his eyes twinkled a little—“Madame’s reputation for discretion stands very high in Diplomatic circles.” “I’m glad they give me a good character,” said Virginia, laughing. “And I’m glad I’m not going to be left out of it.” “What about refreshments?” said Anthony. “Where does the conference take place? Here?” “If you please, sir,” said Battle, “I’ve a fancy for not leaving this room until morning. You’ll see why when you’ve heard the story.” “Then I’ll go and forage,” said Anthony.
